_comment: Copy to accounts.json (git-ignored). Two posting accounts: one FIRST lane (speed: best clip of each moment, posted as soon as it scores) and one BEST lane (captioned finals, rotating streamers). Each posts to all its platforms. via=ayrshare posts publicly today through Ayrshare's audited apps; via=official uses your own API apps (YouTube/TikTok stay PRIVATE until your audits pass; Instagram works in dev mode for your own account).

A.grok_style: Breaking-news energy: say what just happened, fast. Hook <= 5 words, ALL CAPS. Streamer name first in the title. No emojis spam (max 1).

B.grok_style: Highlight-reel voice: polished, a little longer, tease the payoff without spoiling it. Mix in the moment type (chase, glitch, fail). Max 2 emojis.
